# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden who is golden and fair. She is seen wearing silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Despite her spiritual appearance, Priscilla is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Abilities

- writing papers and essays  <sub>[v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- to be famous  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

## History

While attending Queen's Academy, Priscilla formed a close circle of friends with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. She was initially assigned to teach at Carmody school, though she later took her home school instead. She joined the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and read a paper on cemeteries for one of their meetings. During a spring visit, she joined Anne, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews on a woodland walk. While her aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, was visiting the Island, Priscilla brought her and Mrs. Pendexter to visit Green Gables unexpectedly to surprise Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 c20 P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)_
